## Setting the data
```{r data}
library(jpeg)
library(neuralnet)
library(pROC)

pm <- read.csv("C:\\Users\\mehed\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\Math-3333\\photoMetaData.csv")
n <- nrow(pm)

trainFlag <- (runif(n) > 0.2)
y <- as.numeric(pm$category == "outdoor-day")


# Define grid size
grid_rows <- 10
grid_cols <- 10
  
  
X <- matrix(NA, ncol=3*10*10, nrow=n)
for (j in 1:n) {
  img <- readJPEG(paste0("C:\\Users\\mehed\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\Math-3333\\columbiaImages\\columbiaImages\\",pm$name[j]))
  
  
  img_height <- dim(img)[1]  # rows
  img_width <- dim(img)[2]   # columns

  

  # Compute the height and width of each tile
  tile_height <- floor(img_height / grid_rows)
  tile_width <- floor(img_width / grid_cols)

  # Create a list to store the 100 tiles
  tiles <- list()

  # Extract tiles
  count <- 1
  for (i in 0:(grid_rows - 1)) {
    for (k in 0:(grid_cols - 1)) {
      row_start <- i * tile_height + 1
      row_end <- (i + 1) * tile_height
      col_start <- k * tile_width + 1
      col_end <- (k + 1) * tile_width
    
      # Extract the tile
      tile <- img[row_start:row_end, col_start:col_end, ]
      tiles[[count]] <- tile
      count <- count + 1
    }
  }
  
  features <- c()
  for (l in 1:length(tiles)) {
    # Apply median across the 3rd dimension (RGB), and store the result
    features <- c(features, apply(tiles[[l]], 3, median))
  }
  X[j, ] <- features
  
}

photo_data <- as.data.frame(X)
photo_data$outdoor <- y

cut_off = 0.5

trainset <- photo_data[trainFlag, ]
testset <- photo_data[!trainFlag, ]


```

## logistic regression
```{r logistic regression}

# build a glm model on these median values
out <- glm(y ~ X, family=binomial, subset=trainFlag)
out$iter
summary(out)

# How well did we do?
pred <- 1 / (1 + exp(-1 * cbind(1,X) %*% coef(out)))

y[order(pred)]
y[!trainFlag][order(pred[!trainFlag])]

mean((as.numeric(pred > 0.5) == y)[trainFlag])
mean((as.numeric(pred > 0.5) == y)[!trainFlag])




results_logit <- data.frame(actual = y[!trainFlag], prediction = pred[!trainFlag])

results_logit$predicted_class <- ifelse(results_logit$prediction >= cut_off, 1, 0)
roundedresults_logit <- data.frame(actual = results_logit$actual, prediction = results_logit$predicted_class)


conf_mat_logit <- table(roundedresults_logit$actual, roundedresults_logit$prediction)
print(conf_mat_logit)



# Compute ROC and AUC
roc_obj_logit <- roc(results_logit$actual, results_logit$prediction)

# Plot with adjusted parameters
# Assuming roc_obj contains fpr and tpr components
plot(roc_obj_logit$fpr, roc_obj_logit$tpr, 
     type = "l", 
     main = "ROC Curve for Logistic Regression", 
     xlab = "False Positive Rate", 
     ylab = "True Positive Rate",
     col = "#1c61b6", 
     lwd = 2)
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2)  # Add diagonal reference line

# Add AUC if you have it (you'll need to calculate separately)
# text(0.6, 0.2, paste("AUC =", round(auc_value, 3)))


auc_value_logit <- auc(roc_obj_logit)
print(auc_value_logit)







```

## Neural Network

```{r Neural Network}
### Photograph Classification with Neural Network ###







# Create training and test sets


nn <- neuralnet(outdoor ~ ., data=photo_data[trainFlag, ], hidden=c(256,128,64,32), linear.output=FALSE, threshold=0.01)
#nn$result.matrix
#plot(nn)


temp_test <- subset(testset, select = -outdoor)
nn.results <- compute(nn, temp_test)
results <- data.frame(actual = testset$outdoor, prediction = nn.results$net.result)




results$predicted_class <- ifelse(results$prediction >= cut_off, 1, 0)
roundedresultsdf <- data.frame(actual = results$actual, prediction = results$predicted_class)


conf_mat <- table(roundedresultsdf$actual, roundedresultsdf$prediction)
print(conf_mat)


```
## ROC And AUC

```{r ROC}

# Compute ROC and AUC
roc_obj <- roc(results$actual, results$prediction)

# Plot with adjusted parameters
# Assuming roc_obj contains fpr and tpr components
plot(roc_obj$fpr, roc_obj$tpr, 
     type = "l", 
     main = "ROC Curve For Neural Network", 
     xlab = "False Positive Rate", 
     ylab = "True Positive Rate",
     col = "#1c61b6", 
     lwd = 2)
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2)  # Add diagonal reference line

# Add AUC if you have it (you'll need to calculate separately)
# text(0.6, 0.2, paste("AUC =", round(auc_value, 3)))


auc_value <- auc(roc_obj)
print(auc_value)





```
